mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_info (origin_name, store_name, file_path, ext, file_size, content_type, uploader_id, status) VALUES (#{originName}, #{storeName}, #{filePath}, #{ext}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{uploaderId}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT id, origin_name, store_name, file_path, ext, file_size, content_type, uploader_id, create_time, status FROM file_info WHERE id = #{id}
